primary_source.source_problem: Kimberling, A Hard Count; Crux Mathematicorum Problem 2386 (1998)
primary_source.interpretation: Count every physically written cell, including count and label rows; use complete previous-table frequencies.

position_convention.generated_cells: entire count row followed by entire label row
position_convention.general_seed: supplied count row followed by supplied distinct-label row, each cell once

timing.scope: Single wall-clock observations; initial/final snapshot copies excluded; not a benchmark
Single wall-clock observations; snapshot copies excluded; not a benchmark
Single observations; query loop includes local receipt retention, excludes final full snapshot copy; not a benchmark

custody.method: Literal comparisons of already retained data only; no constructor, recurrence, occurrence indexing or query replay.

outcome.convention: count of positions strictly below before_position
count of positions strictly below before_position
